error.zh: 无法加载 Agent 预设。

seatHint.en: Agent preset for the session you are about to start
seatHint.zh: 即将开始的这个会话所用的 Agent 预设

headerHint.en: The agent preset this session runs, fixed when it started
headerHint.zh: 本会话运行的 Agent 预设，开始时即固定

sectionIntro.en: A preset is the plugin composition one session's agent runs — its tools, prompt, and capabilities. Duplicate an existing one and make it yours, or let the agent draft one for you in Creator mode.
sectionIntro.zh: 预设即一个会话的 Agent 所运行的插件组装 —— 它的工具、提示词与能力。复制一份既有预设改成自己的，或用「创造模式」让 Agent 帮你创建。

presetStandardDescription.en: Full coding agent with file editing, shell, file and web search, skills, planning, goals, subagents, and workflows.
presetStandardDescription.zh: 功能完整的编码 Agent，支持文件编辑、Shell、文件与网页检索、Skills、计划、目标、子代理和工作流。

presetPtcDescription.en: Full coding agent without the workflow tool; other tools are exposed through the PTC mode SDK so the model can combine multi-step operations in one TypeScript program.
presetPtcDescription.zh: 功能完整的编码 Agent，但默认不提供 workflow 工具；其他工具通过 PTC 模式 SDK 呈现，让模型用一个 TypeScript 程序组合多步操作。

presetMinimalDescription.en: Single-tool coding agent with a persistent shell.
presetMinimalDescription.zh: 仅提供持久 shell 的单工具编码 Agent。

presetCordisDescription.en: Built for creating custom agent presets, with all Standard mode capabilities plus runtime inspection, plugin experiments, and preset-authoring guidance.
presetCordisDescription.zh: 用于创建自定义 Agent preset：具备标准模式的全部能力，并提供运行时检查、插件实验和 preset 创作指导。

duplicateUnavailable.en: This deployment has no writable preset directory
duplicateUnavailable.zh: 此部署未配置可写的预设目录

displayNamePlaceholder.en: Shown in the picker; defaults to the identifier
displayNamePlaceholder.zh: 选择器中显示的名字，缺省用标识符

brokenNoCopy.en: A preset that failed to load cannot be duplicated
brokenNoCopy.zh: 预设加载失败，不能复制

copyIntro.en: The whole preset is copied on this machine. The identifier becomes its directory name and cannot be changed later; everything else is edited in the preset's own files.
copyIntro.zh: 整个预设会在本机复制一份。标识符将成为目录名，事后无法更改；其余内容之后直接在预设自己的文件里编辑。

creatorDraft.en: Draft a custom preset with Creator mode
creatorDraft.zh: 用「创造模式」创作自定义预设

idInvalid.en: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
idInvalid.zh: 只能使用小写字母、数字与连字符，且以字母或数字开头。

idTaken.en: A preset with this identifier already exists.

deleteDescription.en: The preset directory is deleted. Sessions already running on it keep working; new sessions cannot select it.
deleteDescription.zh: 预设目录将被删除。已在其上运行的会话不受影响；新会话将无法再选择它。

showPickerDescription.en: When enabled, new tasks can choose Standard, PTC, Creator, Minimal, and custom modes. When disabled, all new tasks use the default mode (Standard by default; configurable). Only affects new tasks.
showPickerDescription.zh: 开启后，新任务可选择标准、PTC、创造、极简及自定义模式；关闭后统一使用默认模式（默认为标准模式，可自定义）。仅影响新任务。

enablePickerToSetDefault.en: Turn on Agent mode selection to choose a default
enablePickerToSetDefault.zh: 请先开启 Agent 模式选择，再设置默认模式

enablePickerToCreate.en: Turn on Agent mode selection to start Creator mode
enablePickerToCreate.zh: 请先开启 Agent 模式选择，再启动创造模式
